fields.title: Individual Therapy
fields.short_description: Individual Therapy provides one-on-one, confidential counselling to help individuals overcome personal challenges, improve emotional well-being, build resilience, and achieve lasting personal growth.
fields.description:
Individual Therapy offers a safe, confidential, and supportive environment where you can openly discuss your thoughts, feelings, and life experiences with a qualified counsellor. Whether you are facing emotional difficulties, navigating major life changes, or seeking personal growth, we are here to help you every step of the way.

Our counselling sessions are tailored to your unique needs and goals. Using evidence-based therapeutic approaches, we work collaboratively with you to identify challenges, develop healthy coping strategies, improve emotional regulation, and build the confidence needed to make positive life changes.

Individual Therapy can help with:

• Anxiety and excessive worry
• Depression and low mood
• Stress and burnout
• Grief and loss
• Trauma and emotional healing
• Relationship and family challenges
• Self-esteem and confidence
• Anger management
• Life transitions and personal growth
• Emotional resilience and well-being

Our goal is to empower you with the skills, insight, and support needed to overcome life's challenges, improve your mental health, and lead a more balanced, confident, and fulfilling life.

fields.title: Couples Therapy
fields.short_description: Couples Therapy provides a safe, supportive, and confidential environment where partners can strengthen communication, resolve conflicts, rebuild trust, and develop healthier, more fulfilling relation
fields.description:
Every relationship experiences challenges, but with the right support, couples can learn to navigate difficulties and grow stronger together. Our Couples Therapy service offers a confidential and non-judgmental space where partners can openly discuss concerns, improve communication, and work toward shared goals.

Our experienced counsellors help couples identify patterns that may be affecting their relationship and develop practical strategies to strengthen emotional connection, rebuild trust, and resolve conflicts in healthy, constructive ways. Whether you are dating, engaged, married, or in a long-term partnership, therapy can provide valuable tools for creating a stronger and more satisfying relationship.

This service can help with:

• Communication difficulties
• Frequent conflicts and disagreements
• Trust and relationship rebuilding
• Emotional disconnection
• Premarital counselling
• Parenting and family-related challenges
• Financial and lifestyle conflicts
• Managing life transitions together
• Strengthening intimacy and emotional connection
• Improving problem-solving as a couple

Our goal is to help couples build healthier relationships founded on trust, mutual respect, understanding, and effective communication, enabling them to face life's challenges together with confidence and resilience.

fields.title: Corporate Therapy
fields.short_description: Corporate Therapy supports organizations by promoting employee mental well-being, reducing workplace stress, improving productivity, and fostering a healthy, resilient, and positive work environment.
fields.description:
A healthy workforce is the foundation of a successful organization. Our Corporate Therapy service is designed to help businesses create a supportive workplace culture where employees can thrive both personally and professionally.

We partner with organizations to provide confidential counselling, stress management, and mental wellness programs that address the emotional and psychological challenges employees may face. By supporting employee well-being, organizations can improve morale, strengthen teamwork, reduce burnout, and enhance overall productivity.

Our experienced counsellors work with individuals, teams, and management to develop practical strategies for maintaining a healthy work environment and promoting resilience in the workplace.

This service can help with:

• Workplace stress and burnout
• Employee Assistance Program (EAP) support
• Work-life balance challenges
• Conflict resolution and communication
• Leadership and management support
• Team-building and resilience
• Critical incident and trauma support
• Change management and organizational transitions
• Mental health awareness training
• Employee wellness workshops

Our goal is to help organizations build a positive workplace culture where employees feel supported, motivated, and equipped to perform at their best while maintaining good mental health and emotional well-being.

fields.title: Stress Therapy
fields.short_description: Stress Therapy provides practical, compassionate support to help individuals manage stress, restore emotional balance, build resilience, and improve overall mental and physical well-being.
fields.description:
Stress is a natural part of life, but when it becomes overwhelming or persistent, it can affect your mental health, physical well-being, relationships, and daily performance. Our Stress Therapy service offers a safe, confidential space where you can explore the sources of your stress and develop healthy ways to cope.

Our experienced counsellors work collaboratively with you to identify stress triggers, understand your emotional responses, and create personalized strategies to manage pressure more effectively. Using evidence-based therapeutic approaches, we help you strengthen resilience, improve emotional regulation, and develop healthier habits for long-term well-being.

This service can help with:

• Work-related stress and burnout
• Academic stress and exam pressure
• Family and relationship challenges
• Financial and life-transition stress
• Caregiver stress
• Time management difficulties
• Emotional exhaustion
• Difficulty balancing work and personal life

Our goal is to help you regain a sense of calm, improve your ability to cope with life's challenges, and build lasting skills that promote emotional wellness, confidence, and a healthier, more balanced lifestyle.

fields.title: Depression Therapy
fields.short_description: Depression Therapy offers compassionate, confidential support to help individuals overcome feelings of sadness, hopelessness, low motivation, and emotional distress while building resilience and impro
fields.description:
Depression can make everyday life feel overwhelming, affecting your emotions, relationships, work, studies, and overall quality of life. You do not have to face these challenges alone.

Our Depression Therapy service provides a safe, supportive, and confidential environment where you can openly discuss your thoughts and feelings without fear of judgment. Our experienced counsellors work with you to understand the underlying causes of your depression and develop practical strategies to promote healing and recovery.

Using evidence-based therapeutic approaches, we help you identify negative thought patterns, strengthen healthy coping skills, rebuild self-confidence, and create realistic goals for long-term emotional well-being.

This service can help with:

• Persistent sadness or low mood
• Loss of interest in activities once enjoyed
• Feelings of hopelessness or worthlessness
• Low self-esteem and lack of motivation
• Emotional exhaustion
• Difficulty concentrating
• Grief and life transitions
• Stress-related depression

Our goal is to help you rediscover hope, improve your emotional health, strengthen resilience, and support you in living a healthier, more fulfilling life—one step at a time.

fields.title: Anxiety Therapy
fields.short_description: Anxiety Therapy provides a safe, confidential space to help individuals manage anxiety, panic attacks, excessive worry, stress, and related emotional challenges using evidence-based counselling approa
fields.description:
Anxiety can affect every aspect of life, from work and school to relationships and physical well-being. Our Anxiety Therapy service provides compassionate, confidential support to help you understand the root causes of your anxiety and develop practical strategies to manage it.

Our qualified counsellors use evidence-based therapeutic approaches tailored to your individual needs. Together, we will identify triggers, challenge unhelpful thought patterns, build healthy coping skills, and improve emotional resilience.

This service can help with:

• Generalized anxiety
• Panic attacks
• Social anxiety
• Health anxiety
• Excessive worry and overthinking
• Stress management
• Fear and phobias
• Anxiety related to work, school, or relationships

Our goal is to empower you with the confidence and tools needed to regain control, improve your emotional well-being, and enjoy a more balanced and fulfilling life.

fields.title: Managing Anxiety in Young Adults
fields.short_description: Helping a young professional overcome anxiety through Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT), mindfulness, and personalized coping strategies.
fields.description: This case study highlights how structured counselling helped a young adult manage anxiety that was affecting both personal and professional life. Through evidence-based Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT), mindfulness practices, and practical coping techniques, the client developed healthier thought patterns, reduced anxiety symptoms, and regained confidence in social and workplace environments.
fields.client_profile: Age: 24, experiencing work and social anxiety, struggling with constant worry, overthinking, and fear of judgment in everyday interactions.”
fields.challenge: The client experienced panic attacks during presentations and avoided social gatherings, leading to isolation.
fields.approach:
Weekly CBT sessions
Mindfulness and breathing techniques
Personalized anxiety-management plan
fields.outcome: After 10 weeks, the client reported fewer panic attacks, improved confidence at work, and renewed social life.

fields.title: Supporting Couples in Conflict
fields.short_description: Helping couples rebuild trust, improve communication, and strengthen their relationship through professional couples counselling.
fields.description: This case study demonstrates how structured couples counselling helped a married couple overcome recurring conflict, rebuild trust, and develop healthier communication patterns. Through evidence-based therapeutic techniques and guided exercises, they learned practical ways to resolve disagreements respectfully and reconnect emotionally.
fields.client_profile: Couple, Restoring Balance for a Couple Married for 7 Years Facing Conflict
fields.challenge: The couple experienced recurring arguments, unresolved misunderstandings, and trust issues that created emotional distance. Poor communication patterns made it difficult to resolve disagreements, leaving both partners feeling unheard and disconnected.
fields.approach:
Structured couples therapy sessions
Active listening exercises
Conflict-resolution and problem-solving techniques
Guided communication exercises
Relationship goal-setting
Homework activities to practice healthy communication between sessions
Trust-building strategies
fields.outcome: After completing the counselling program, the couple reported improved communication, greater understanding of each other's perspectives, and healthier ways of resolving conflict. Trust gradually strengthened, emotional intimacy increased, and they felt more confident working together to navigate future challenges.

fields.title: Work-Life Balance for Professionals
fields.short_description: Helping professionals overcome burnout, reduce stress, and achieve a healthier balance between work and personal life.
fields.description: This case study showcases how personalized counselling helped a working professional manage chronic stress and burnout caused by a demanding career. Through practical stress-management strategies, relaxation techniques, and healthier lifestyle habits, the client improved their overall well-being, productivity, and work-life balance.
fields.client_profile: Age: 35, Burnout and stress from demanding job
fields.challenge: The client struggled with overwhelming responsibilities, persistent stress, insomnia, mental fatigue, and low energy. These challenges affected productivity, relationships, and overall quality of life.
fields.approach:
Stress-management techniques, including time-blocking and prioritization
Relaxation exercises
Guided meditation sessions
Development of healthy sleep hygiene habits
Nutrition and healthy eating guidance
Encouragement of regular physical exercise
Work-life boundary-setting strategies
Weekly progress reviews and goal adjustments
fields.outcome: After eight weeks of counselling, the client reported better sleep quality, increased focus, reduced stress levels, and renewed energy. They successfully established healthier work-life boundaries, improved daily routines, and felt more in control of both their professional and personal responsibilities.

fields.title: Building Self-Esteem in Adolescents
fields.short_description: Supporting adolescents in developing self-confidence, resilience, and a positive self-image through professional counselling.
fields.description: This case study highlights how counselling helped an adolescent build healthier self-esteem, challenge negative thought patterns, and develop greater confidence in academic and social settings. Through a supportive and strengths-based approach, the client learned practical skills to improve self-worth, communication, and emotional resilience.
fields.client_profile: Age: 15, BLow self-confidence, negative self-talk, reluctance to participate in class
fields.challenge: The client struggled with feelings of inadequacy, fear of making mistakes, and difficulty recognizing personal strengths. These challenges affected classroom participation, peer relationships, and overall emotional well-being.
fields.approach:
Weekly individual counselling sessions
Strength-based counselling techniques
Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) exercises to challenge negative self-talk
Confidence-building activities and goal setting
Communication and social skills development
Journaling and self-reflection exercises
Positive affirmation and self-compassion practices
Parental guidance to reinforce progress at home
fields.outcome: After 12 weeks of counselling, the client demonstrated increased self-confidence, participated more actively in class, developed healthier thinking patterns, and built stronger relationships with peers. They reported greater self-acceptance and felt more comfortable expressing themselves in both academic and social environments.

fields.title: Finding Healing Through Grief and Loss Support
fields.short_description: Providing compassionate support to help individuals navigate grief, process loss, and gradually rebuild hope for the future.
fields.description: This case study demonstrates how compassionate grief counselling supported an individual following the sudden loss of a loved one. Through a safe and supportive therapeutic environment, the client learned healthy ways to process emotions, develop coping strategies, and gradually adjust to life while honoring their loss.
fields.client_profile: Age: 45, Coping with the sudden loss of a loved one
fields.challenge: The client struggled with overwhelming sadness, difficulty concentrating, disrupted sleep, and feelings of loneliness. Everyday responsibilities became challenging, and they found it difficult to process their emotions while adapting to significant life changes.
fields.approach:
Compassionate one-on-one grief counselling sessions
A safe space to express emotions without judgment
Psychoeducation about the grieving process
Mindfulness and grounding techniques for emotional regulation
Healthy coping strategies for managing difficult emotions
Memory and legacy activities to honor the loved one
Self-care planning and rebuilding daily routines
Gradual goal-setting to regain confidence and purpose
fields.outcome: After several weeks of counselling, the client reported feeling better equipped to cope with grief and navigate daily life. While continuing to honor the memory of their loved one, they experienced improved emotional resilience, healthier coping strategies, better sleep, and renewed hope for the future.

fields.title: Overcoming Teenage Depression: Building Hope and Emotional Resilience
fields.short_description: Helping adolescents overcome depression by fostering hope, emotional resilience, and healthy coping strategies through professional counselling.
fields.description: This case study highlights how compassionate, evidence-based counselling supported a teenager experiencing symptoms of depression. Through individual therapy, family involvement, and practical coping techniques, the client gradually regained confidence, improved emotional well-being, and re-engaged with school, friendships, and daily life.
fields.client_profile: Age: 16, Feelings of worthlessness, withdrawal from school and friends
fields.challenge: The client had become increasingly isolated, lost interest in activities they previously enjoyed, and struggled with low self-esteem, poor concentration, and declining academic performance. These difficulties affected relationships with family and peers and reduced their confidence in everyday life.
fields.approach:
Weekly individual counselling sessions
Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) techniques
Emotional awareness and healthy expression exercises
Goal-setting to rebuild confidence and motivation
Mindfulness and stress-management practices
Development of healthy coping strategies
Family sessions to strengthen support at home
Encouragement of positive routines, hobbies, and social engagement
fields.outcome: After 12 weeks of counselling, the client reported improved mood, increased confidence, and healthier coping strategies for managing difficult emotions. They gradually re-engaged with school activities, strengthened relationships with family and friends, and developed greater emotional resilience and hope for the future.

fields.question: What is counselling?
fields.answer: Counselling is a confidential, supportive process where a trained therapist helps you explore you thoughts, feelings, and behaviors to better understand yourself and work through challenges.

fields.question: Who is counselling for?
fields.answer: Counselling is for anyone seeking support — whether you’re facing stress, anxiety, relationship issues, trauma, or simply want personal growth and clarity.

fields.question: How do I know if I need counselling?
fields.answer: If you’re feeling overwhelmed, stuck, or emotionally drained — or just want a safe space to talk — counselling can help. It’s okay to seek support even if you’re unsure what’s “wrong.”

fields.question: What issues can you help with?
fields.answer: We support clients dealing with anxiety, depression, self-esteem issues,  trauma, grief, relationship and family problems, life transitions, and  more.

fields.question: Is counselling confidential?
fields.answer: Yes. Everything you share is kept confidential unless there’s a risk of harm to you or others.

fields.question: Do you offer online sessions?
fields.answer: Yes, we offer both in-person and secure online counselling sessions for  your convenience.

fields.question: How do I book a session?
fields.answer: You can book via our website, phone, or contact form. We'll guide you through the next steps.

fields.question: What are your fees and payment options?
fields.answer: Session fees and payment options vary. We accept M-Pesa, PayPal, and bank  transfer. Sliding scale fees available on request.

fields.name: Erastus Ivelia
fields.title: Professional Counsellor & Mental Wellness Practitioner
fields.short_bio: Erastus Ivelia is a compassionate counselling professional dedicated to helping individuals, couples, and families navigate life's challenges and achieve greater emotional well-being. He provides a safe, confidential, and supportive environment where clients can feel heard, understood, and empowered to grow.
fields.bio:
Erastus Ivelia is a dedicated counselling professional committed to helping individuals, couples, families, and organizations achieve emotional well-being and personal growth. Through a compassionate and client-centered approach, he provides guidance, support, and practical strategies for navigating life's challenges.

With over 5 years of counselling experience, Erastus has worked with diverse individuals and groups, helping them develop healthier coping strategies, strengthen relationships, manage emotional challenges, and improve their overall mental wellness.

He believes that every client is unique and deserves to be treated with dignity, empathy, and respect. His approach focuses on creating a safe and confidential environment where clients can openly explore their concerns and work toward meaningful and lasting change.

fields.title: Managing Anxiety in Everyday Life
fields.short_description: Join our practical workshop to learn healthy strategies for managing anxiety, reducing stress, and supporting your emotional and mental well-being.
fields.description:
This interactive workshop is designed to help participants understand anxiety, identify common triggers, and develop practical coping strategies for everyday life. Through guided discussions, relaxation techniques, and evidence-based approaches, attendees will gain valuable tools to improve their mental well-being and build resilience.

Whether you're experiencing anxiety yourself or supporting someone who is, this session provides a safe and welcoming environment to learn, ask questions, and connect with others.
fields.venue: Redeemed Christian Church of God, Nairobi

fields.title: Parenting with Confidence Seminar
fields.short_description: Gain practical parenting strategies to strengthen communication, build healthy relationships, and support your child's emotional and mental well-being.
fields.description: Join us for an engaging seminar designed to equip parents and caregivers with practical tools for raising confident, resilient, and emotionally healthy children. Led by experienced counselors, this session explores positive parenting techniques, effective communication, discipline with empathy, and strategies for nurturing children's emotional growth in today's changing world. Whether you are a new parent or have teenagers, this seminar offers valuable insights to help you navigate the parenting journey with confidence.

fields.title: Depression Recovery Talk
fields.short_description: Learn to recognize the signs of depression, explore effective coping strategies, and discover pathways to healing and recovery in a supportive environment.
fields.description: Depression affects people of all ages and backgrounds, but with the right support, recovery is possible. This educational talk is designed to increase awareness of depression, reduce stigma, and encourage early intervention. Experienced mental health professionals will discuss common symptoms, risk factors, healthy coping strategies, treatment options, and ways to support yourself or someone experiencing depression. Participants will also have an opportunity to ask questions in a safe and confidential setting.
